items.title: Opening at Old Trafford
items.description: The video opens at Old Trafford, highlighting the Soccer Aid event as it marks the first appearance in three years.

items.title: Williams Redknapp McClure return
items.description: Bobby Williams, Harry Redknapp, Vicky McClure, Robbie Williams and Zavon Hines appear, marking their return after last year's Soccer Aid.

items.title: Maisie Adam gives ball away
items.description: Maisie Adam, who married yesterday, gives the ball away early in the match while Bobby Williams, Harry Redknapp and Vicky McClure watch.

items.title: Foster beaten, England leads
items.description: Ben Foster fails to stop a shot, giving England a lead, while Francesco Totti, Hernán Crespo and David James are shown on screen.

items.title: Totti Crespo James shown
items.description: Francesco Totti, Hernán Crespo and David James appear as England leads 2-1.

items.title: Funds raised for Unicef
items.description: The match highlights a £750 donation to Unicef while referencing Totti, Crespo and David James.

items.title: Brian McFadden raises funds
items.description: Brian McFadden is praised for raising £11,000 for Unicef during the show.

items.title: Fletcher advantage play
items.description: Darren Fletcher gains advantage as Foxy Malone challenges him, while Brian McFadden and Jonathan Cyprien are noted.

items.title: Advantage play and near miss
items.description: Referee plays advantage after Foxy Malone challenges a player, Darren Fletcher assists, and Macy Adam nearly scores.

items.title: Near miss reaction
items.description: Commentary reacts to Macy Adam's close chance, calling it a near wedding gift.

items.title: Gary Neville introduces boys to Old Trafford
items.description: Gary Neville comments on the atmosphere and introduces the boys to Old Trafford after Macy Adam's near miss.

items.title: Gary Neville discusses Jill Scott and Lionesses
items.description: Gary Neville talks about Jill Scott being signed by Soccerway, her European championship win, and mentions Jamaica.

items.title: Billy Joe DuPree mentioned
items.description: Commentary references Billy Joe DuPree while discussing a gym anecdote.

items.title: David James scores after 5k
items.description: After a 5k run, David James releases the ball, slips it past Davey James and scores.

items.title: Usain Bolt scores first goal
items.description: Usain Bolt, the world's fastest man, scores the first goal of Shot Parade 2023 after a 5k run.

items.title: Usain Bolt celebrated as Manchester United fan
items.description: Commentary celebrates Usain Bolt's goal, noting he is a Manchester United fan who scored at Old Trafford.

items.title: Fan scores at Old Trafford, celebrates
items.description: A Manchester United fan scores at Old Trafford and celebrates with a trademark move, joined by Patrice Evra and Usain Bolt.

items.title: Player scores past David James
items.description: A player slots the ball past goalkeeper David James after a trademark celebration with Manchester United Legends.

items.title: Ball slips past David James
items.description: The ball is slipped past goalkeeper David James following a hamstring injury mention.

items.title: Wilshere curls, Cahill headers, Foster claims
items.description: Jack Wilshere curls the ball toward Jill Scott, Gary Cahill heads it, and Ben Foster makes a claim, while Sir Mo Farah replaces Bugsy Malone.

items.title: Wilshere to Scott, Cahill heads
items.description: Jack Wilshere curls the ball toward Jill Scott as Gary Cahill heads it and Ben Foster makes a claim.

items.title: Wilshere curls, Cahill heads, Evra Bolt appear
items.description: Jack Wilshere curls toward Jill Scott, Gary Cahill heads the ball, while Patrice Evra and Usain Bolt appear on screen.

items.title: Cahill defended by Carney and Wilshire
items.description: Gary Cahill is challenged by Carney and Wilshire as Jack Wilshere receives a great ball from Tossi Beck Nanny.

items.title: Beck Nanny tests James, Austin reacts
items.description: Tossi Beck Nanny plays a ball that tests goalkeeper David James, prompting a reaction from Austin.

items.title: David James makes a decent stop
items.description: David James makes a decent stop on a shot, while Austin reacts.

items.title: Gilligan's run and David James stop
items.description: David James makes a stop as Gilligan attempts a run, with commentators referencing Billy Joe DuPree and Carlos Hyde.

items.title: Gilligan's run and trick attempt
items.description: Gilligan makes a run, attempts a trick to get past a defender, while commentators note the effort.

items.title: Player continues attack
items.description: A player continues the attack, attempting to finish the play.

items.title: Fletcher praised as England threat
items.description: Commentators note Fletcher will be a thorn for England, mention Everett's fitness and David Jones involvement.

items.title: Deflection leads to James save
items.description: Everett's shot takes a deflection, David Jones is involved, but David James makes a save.

items.title: Carney fouled, free kick awarded
items.description: Karen Carney is knocked down outside the box, winning a free kick for England after a deflection and James correction.

items.title: Carney wins free kick after foul
items.description: Karen Carney is fouled by Claflin, earning a dangerous free kick for England.

items.title: England wins free kick near penalty
items.description: Claflin gives away a free kick to England after a clumsy challenge on Sakurai, with Mr Sun observing the incident.

items.title: Butterfield appears as England presses
items.description: After the free kick, Wilshire and teammates crowd the penalty edge while Butterfield is identified as the player involved.

items.title: Goalkeeper discussion as Butterfield noted
items.description: Wilshire and England players press near the box while the commentator references Butterfield and other goalkeepers' involvement.

items.title: Gary Cahill comments on first touch
items.description: Gary Cahill is shown discussing the player's first touch after the goalkeeper's involvement.

items.title: Leon Edwards devastated as ball slices past
items.description: Kipper and Ace anticipate a cross, but the ball slices past Leon Edwards, who looks devastated.

items.title: Butterfield scores to equalize 1-1
items.description: Ace of Butterfield finishes the cross into the net, making the score 1-1 after Leon Edwards is beaten.

items.title: Hiddleston advances after Butterfield goal
items.description: Following Butterfield's goal, Wilshire attempts a clearance and Hiddleston pursues a lovely ball forward.

items.title: Hiddleston continues the attack
items.description: Hiddleston keeps possession and moves forward after the previous play.

items.title: Paul Scholes watches Hiddleston's play
items.description: Paul Scholes is seen observing as Tom Hiddleston moves forward with a lovely ball and attempts a pass involving a girl.

items.title: Stormzy comments on Paul Scholes' halftime situation
items.description: Stormzy is shown laughing while noting that the team is one nil down at halftime, with Paul Scholes mentioned.

items.title: Paul Scholes scores; Redknapp, Stormzy, Cove react
items.description: Paul Scholes scores for Soccer Aid, while Harry Redknapp, Stormzy and Cove react as the play restarts.

items.title: Tom Grant's ball leads to Leon's clearance attempt
items.description: Tom Grant delivers a brilliant ball, Leon tries to knock it out but it falls short, setting up a chance for Paul Scholes.

items.title: Scholes scores outside‑foot goal for 2‑1 lead
items.description: Paul Scholes strikes the ball with the outside of his foot into the net, putting England ahead 2‑1.

items.title: England goes 2‑1 up with outside‑foot strike
items.description: An unnamed player scores with an outside‑foot shot, giving England a 2‑1 lead.

items.title: Robbie Keane praised after England's 2‑1 lead
items.description: Robbie Keane is highlighted as the action returns to him following England's 2‑1 advantage.

items.title: Pochettino, Melanie C and Keane see Ireland level
items.description: Mauricio Pochettino and Melanie C appear as Robbie Keane notes the Irish side has leveled the match.

items.title: Robbie King scores screamer
items.description: Robbie King scores an absolute screamer, bringing World XI level with England at 2-2.

items.title: Evra squares off Kino
items.description: Patrice Evra wins the ball and squares it off, focusing on his next move.

items.title: Evra squares ball Robbie key
items.description: Patrice Evra wins the ball and squares it off, followed by a comment about Robbie Keane's involvement.

items.title: Robbie key praises Martin Compston
items.description: Robbie Keane comments that Martin Compston delivered a strong hit and is a great player.

items.title: Martin Compston stays fit Edwards quick
items.description: Martin Compston is noted for staying fit since retiring, while goalkeeper Edwards rushes out quickly to deny a shot at Tom's feet.

items.title: Cahill clears Bobby Keen strikes
items.description: Edwards rushes out, Cahill clears the ball, and Bobby Keen strikes again after the rebound.

items.title: World XI takes lead via Cahill
items.description: After Cahill's clearance and Bobby Keen's strike, World XI scores to go ahead 3-2 against England.

items.title: Robbie Keane assists Noah
items.description: Robbie Keane delivers a lovely pass to Noah, setting up World XI's latest goal.

items.title: Noah Bet levels pass, Irishman dinks
items.description: Noah bet receives a delivery and levels the ball, then the Irishman executes a delicate dink.

items.title: Irishman dinks, Embrace celebrates
items.description: After the Irishman's dink, Embrace finishes the play and celebrates the goal.

items.title: Embrace celebrates finish
items.description: Embrace is highlighted as the player who finishes the move and celebrates the outcome.

items.title: Embrace expresses love for Soccer Aid
items.description: Embrace states that he absolutely loves being involved in Soccer Aid every single year.

items.title: Chuck reacts, Force heads ball
items.description: Chuck sees the action, Force throws his head at the ball, producing a quick reaction.

items.title: Ball carried loose after touch
items.description: Following the best touch, the ball runs loose and is carried away by a player.

items.title: Ken eyes record, aims for win
items.description: The player has five on his mind, aiming to finish the play and secure the record, with Ken likely to win.

items.title: Ken Saturday tops Soccer Aid scoring
items.description: Ken Saturday is identified as the player who has scored the most goals in Soccer Aid history.

items.title: Ken Saturday named top scorer
items.description: Ken Saturday is announced as the new highest goal scorer in Soccer Aid and expresses delight at the achievement.

items.title: Ken Saturday scores past Clarence
items.description: Ken Saturday scores a lovely goal, getting past Dutch legend Clarence, and his performance is praised.

items.title: Ken Saturday goal after Farah pass
items.description: After a loose pass by Mo Farah, Ken Saturday scores past Clarence, finishing a strong run.

items.title: Ken Saturday scores past Paddy McGinnis
items.description: Ken Saturday slots the ball past Paddy McGinnis Kim setona following a run, with Mo Farah involved earlier in the play.

items.title: Ken Saturday desires victory
items.description: Ken Saturday states that what he really wants is victory after scoring the goal.

items.title: Scarlet Douglas replaces Alex Brooker
items.description: Scarlet Douglas comes on to replace Alex Brooker, who is described as one hell of a fella.

items.title: Scarlet Douglas praised after substitution
items.description: Scarlet Douglas is celebrated after entering the match, while Alex Brooker is again praised as a great player.

items.title: World 11 celebrate with Mauricio Pochettino
items.description: The World 11 team celebrates their fifth straight win, led by Mauricio Pochettino, with Scarlet Douglas and Alex Brooker noted in the festivities.

items.title: World XI Celebration
items.description: The World XI team celebrates their victory, led by Maurizio, while on-screen prompts encourage donations to Soccer Aid.

items.title: Donation Thank You
items.description: Dermot O'Leary thanks viewers for raising £6,905 for UNICEF and expresses gratitude for the support.

items.title: Thank Players and Staff
items.description: Dermot O'Leary and Robbie Williams thank the players, managers, and coaching teams, urging further donations.

items.title: Donation Reminder
items.description: Miriam Aïda, Robbie Williams, and Dermot O'Leary remind viewers that donations go to UNICEF and can be made until midday July 11, 2023.

items.title: Partnership Sponsorship
items.description: On-screen shows partnership logos with Primark and WeShop, reinforcing the donation call-to-action.
